title: Debounce a search box in six lines

scenes.headline: Stop searching on every keystroke
scenes.narration: Every keystroke fires a request, and your server pays for each one. Debouncing fixes that in a few lines.

scenes.headline: The whole function
scenes.narration: Wrap your handler. Each new call cancels the previous timer, so only the last one runs after the pause.

scenes.headline: Use it on the input
scenes.narration: Pass your search function through debounce, then attach the result to the input event.

scenes.headline: Pick the wait carefully
scenes.narration: Three hundred milliseconds is a good default. Shorter feels instant, longer feels laggy.

scenes.headline: Ship it today
scenes.narration: Replace one raw input handler with a debounced one and watch your request count drop.
